title: Aphel setup
description: Set up the organization and the administrator account. This wizard appears only once.

hints.timezone: Used in dates, reminders and reports. Can be changed later.

errors.passwordLength: The password must be between 8 and 128 characters.
errors.statusFailed: Could not check whether Aphel is already installed.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your network and try again.
errors.generic: The installation could not be completed. Please try again.

email.title: Outgoing email
email.description: Set up the SMTP server used for invitations, password resets and notifications. You can skip this step and do it later.
email.later: Without outgoing email, invitations and password resets show a link for you to copy and hand over. You can change it in Settings → Outgoing email.

restore.title: Restore from a backup
restore.description: Use the backup file (.zip) exported from another Aphel installation. Restoring is only possible on this empty installation.
restore.hint: The backup brings the organization, users, records and files. Afterwards, sign in with an account from the backup.

errors.tooLarge: The file is larger than allowed.
errors.generic: Could not restore the backup. Try again.

selection.profilesHint: Use a profile as a starting point and adjust the modules for your company.
selection.shelfHint: These modules need configuration. Explore their benefits and add the ones that fit your needs.
selection.reviewHint: Check the modules that will be available. You can change your selection in settings later.
selection.showAll: Also show modules from other profiles
selection.partial: Some modules in this profile are unavailable in this build.
selection.configurationHint: Configure this module and its dependencies. Values will be saved when installation completes.
selection.invalidConfiguration: Check the configuration of selected modules. Reopen the items to correct the highlighted fields.

profilesDescriptions.freelancer: Organize clients, appointments and quotes for independent work.
profilesDescriptions.agency: Track opportunities, proposals and client relationships.
profilesDescriptions.real_estate: Capture and distribute leads and coordinate team outreach.
profilesDescriptions.consultancy: Organize meetings, proposals and sales approvals.
profilesDescriptions.saas: Track acquisition, qualification, renewals and goals.
profilesDescriptions.sales: Manage prospecting, performance and sales forecasts.
